assets.transformation: User-authorized lossless RGBA alpha bounding-box crop with Pillow 12.3.0. Only fully transparent outer rows/columns removed; no resampling, upscaling, recoloring or redrawing. Crop box uses left/top inclusive and right/bottom exclusive coordinates. Lossless indexed PNG encoding: map every distinct RGBA tuple to one palette index with per-index alpha; decoded RGBA bytes proven identical. ZopfliPNG lossless compression with lossy_transparent=False, lossy_8bit=False, num_iterations=15; decoded RGBA bytes verified unchanged.
